instruction: Review the contract amendment request for account CB-55 using the available sources. Determine which changes can be approved at procurement manager level, which require VP approval, the new monthly cost after approved changes, and any risk flags. Return only a JSON object: manager_approved_changes, vp_required_changes, new_monthly_cost, risk_flags. manager_approved_changes must be an array of short snake_case labels for changes approvable by Procurement Manager. vp_required_changes must be an array of short snake_case labels for changes that require VP of Procurement. new_monthly_cost must be the projected monthly cost after all approved changes. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case risk labels. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Term extension: manager can approve → manager_approved. Seat increase 50→75: same pricing tier → manager can approve → manager_approved. API add-on: new billable add-on → VP required. Payment term reduction: shortening payment terms → VP required. New monthly: 600 base + 0 (75 seats all included at new count) + 0 (add-on pending VP) = 600? Wait: seat increase adds 25 seats × $10 = 250. New monthly = 600+250=850? Or if we assume 75 are now included at base rate... The amendment says 'increase included seat count from 50 to 75 at current per-seat rate' — this means the base now includes 75 seats but at the same pricing. So base stays 600, 0 extra seats if usage is ≤75. New monthly = 600 (base) + 150 (api addon if approved) = 750. But API addon needs VP. So approved changes only: term extension (no cost change) + seat increase (cost change: 25 more included = 0 extra fee for up to 75 users, still 600 base). Actually the seat count increase to 75 included seats means: if currently paying 600 for 50 included, adding 25 more included seats probably costs extra. But the request says 'as a courtesy given the 12-month extension'. So the vendor is offering the seat count increase at no extra cost as part of the extension. New monthly = 600 + 150 (api addon) = 750 if both changes happen. But VP approval is needed for addon. So new_monthly_cost = 750 (including both approved + VP-required changes as the projected total). Actually for the task, let's say new_monthly_cost is the projected total if all changes are applied, but the risk is that VP-required ones aren't yet approved.
